latest_release.name: v6.1.18
latest_release.body:
V6 brings ChatGPT Web models into Codex's model and Effort selectors, optional Pro usage estimates, Bigger Context, and control over browser conversations. **6.1.18 improves long-task continuation, preserves goal changes, and fixes macOS passkey-session import.**

> [!IMPORTANT]
> If Codex shows only Luna (Web) despite a paid ChatGPT account, install this update, open **Setup → Install into Codex → Reinstall**, and fully restart Codex. The update preserves your launcher settings and ChatGPT profile.

## Changes in 6.1.18

- **Current workspace folders survive partial updates and compaction.** The bridge checks the folders recorded in the current native Codex session instead of relying only on the task's initial folders. This addresses the partial visualization-folder update in #939 and improves recovery for the related missing-folder and compaction reports in #936 and #945. Working-directory, permission and task-ownership checks remain enforced; those two related reports still need confirmation on the affected tasks.
- **Goal changes remain effective during commands and after compaction.** Clearing or editing a goal during a running command no longer creates a false turn-ID conflict. The completed command result is preserved, and later compaction keeps the updated goal instead of reviving the previous task (#957).
- **Automatic compaction can run before the next instruction arrives.** An exact completed checkpoint can identify the previous task when native Codex starts pre-turn compaction before adding the next instruction. This does not authorize replaying an old task in another ordinary turn (#935).
- **Old messages returning into view are not new submissions.** Previously observed messages that reappear while scrolling a retained ChatGPT conversation no longer cause false multiple-turn errors. A genuinely competing new submission is still rejected (#948).
- **macOS passkey sign-in closes its dedicated Chrome cleanly.** Continue requests a normal Chrome shutdown and waits for a clean exit before importing the session, allowing pending cookies to be saved. This addresses the lost-session failure reported with a YubiKey; an unclean exit now stops the import with an explicit error (#973, thanks @zm2231).
- **Update checks explain failures and allow a manual retry.** Settings exposes update-check errors and a check-again action; GitHub rate-limit reset times are respected. Safe diagnostics also retain recognized browser network error codes without exposing response bodies.
- **Build dependencies are patched.** Vite and the affected minimatch dependencies are updated, while the legacy archive dependencies retain their required APIs.

## Earlier V6 patches

- **Model controls and setup.** The October inline picker is recognized alongside supported earlier layouts. Setup preserves the previous configuration when an interface is unrecognized, instead of incorrectly replacing paid models with Luna. Existing installations affected by #932 need the model refresh described above.
- **Additional workspace folders.** Full Access tasks can continue after Codex adds its visualization or output folder. Current projects, working directory and permissions remain checked (#933).
- **Large compaction and targeted recovery.** Bigger Context compaction can trim older history when rebuilding a lost chat, preserving the latest checkpoint and instruction. Targeted delivery-timeout and multipart-staging recovery avoids resubmitting accepted tool work (#929, #930).

## V6 features and earlier fixes

- **Models and effort.** Account-supported GPT-5.6 and GPT-6 models appear in Codex's native picker. Sol reasoning uses Effort, Instant keeps a separate context budget, and Free accounts expose Luna/Think. Earlier patches improved translated controls, Pro verification, locked options, exact Sol/Astra selection, six-position controls and Browser Smoke cancellation.
